notes.title: New quests and items
notes.notes:
Heroes of Eviron,
In the near future, the game will be updated. What will it bring you?

- Changes in storyline quests: more than 30 new quests have been added for all Generals. In the future, they will be regularly added.

- New item in the shop - Lollipop of Speed. With it, you can instantly get 10 levels of the current Season.

- The game has a new set of armor "Defender of Generals". You will receive parts of it for completing Story quests, and the last missing item can be purchased in the "Armor" section of the Eviron Store.

Good Luck Heroes of Eviron in battles!

notes.title: Good news before holidays
notes.notes:
Heroes of Eviron, we have some good news before upcoming holidays!

- In Battle Weeks, the number of battles fought  will now be displayed. To do this, you need to hover over the number of points in the Battle Week rating table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000082/8f91e95242cfb0ce70ee2e0c08475fd811cc3679.jpg[/img]

- Experience gained for victories in Blitz mode is doubled, and in Ranked Battles mode incresed 5 times. At the same time, experience for defeats in both modes is also doubled.

Enjoy your battles!

notes.title: New system of Seasons and Battle Pass
notes.notes:
Tommorow we'll be glad to represent you new System of Seasons in Eviron.
- Every Season now longs 1 month;
- Less experiense needed to get all rewards;
- At the end of each season your current level will be dropped to 10 lvl. So you will be ready for next one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000082/bd17fdf0eef75df67e91f98234e3f5125330763d.jpg[/img]

Also we changed Battle Pass system.
- Now every level has 2 rewards - Common and reachable with Battle Pass
- At the end of Season Battle Pass will be deleted.


All these improvements will be available tommorow! Hope, that they will be good appreciated by Heroes of Eviron!

notes.title: Battle weeks
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000082/38742e06306f3dcd0dd85b5c7f4373be024a0093.png[/img]

Heroes of Eviron, we are pleased to inform you about tommorow appearance of Battle Weeks.

You will fight in the Arena, in the Crypts, complete tasks, but at the same time you will receive points if they meet the conditions of the current Battle Week. Conditions will change every week. 

At the moment, there are 7 variants of the Battle Week - Fire Release, Water Release, Earth Release, Air Release, Life Release, Death Release, Arena Battles. 

Also we added gold coins to prizes in Arena battles. The quantity of coins depends on mode of Arena battles and your luck.

Go for it, Heroes! Valuable prizes await you at the end of the Week!

notes.title: Changes to the Crypts of the Fallen
notes.notes:
Fel Fighters, great news for you! The revamped Crypts of the Fallen where your adventures will take on a whole new meaning will be opened to you tommorow. So, let’s start:

- Each Crypt now has 4 floors. When you clear the first one you can go to the next.
- Each battle of the Crypt can be played by one General only once. After winning and receiving the reward, the commander will disappear from the list of available ones upon a new attempt. So, each battle can bring you rewards 6 times.
- Each floor of the Crypt now consists of 12 battles, three of which are Bosses.
- Introduced Energy that will be consumed when attacking enemies in Crypts. It is replenished over time or with the help of a Vial of Energy, which can be purchased in the Store of Eviron or received as a reward for battles.
- Excess armors can now be destroyed, gaining character’s experience for them.
- The system of armors has been reworked. Now even one thing plays an important role, even without set bonuses.
- The chance to get armor now exists not only in battles with Bosses, but also in regular battles.
- We change the role of Rage parameter in Crypts. Each floor of the Crypt is now 0.25 Fury stronger than the previous one.

Hopefully all of the Fel Slayers in Eviron will enjoy these innovations! See you in battles against Fel!

notes.title: First steps on new road
Rank battles and other changes...
notes.notes:
Heroes,
The game will be updated tomorrow. Here are the major changes of this update:]

- New mode "Rating Battles", where you can start your ascent in Warriors' Leagues, receiving significant rewards for taking new ranks.

[img]https://sun9-14.userapi.com/impg/lugM9yKbBd_Wi79-KGAivIC9tDDDp-JMHUyFvQ/9gMRTrJqklg.jpg?size=1261x713&quality=96&sign=4cd194cf49bde94ed5b0c9e3f0e8f367&type=album[/img]

- New lines of Story quests. You must deserve the trust of four Generals - Aelania, Artox, Ichthyanda and Mortimor.
- modes "Battles" and "Arena" are temporarily closed for reworking.
- the "Blitz" mode is again available to you.  According to reviews, it was popular and liked by most part of players.
- We open access to the second Crypt, where new exciting battles, puzzles and prizes awaits you.
- settings for Crypts and item bonuses related to Rage are changed. 

Good luck Heroes of Eviron! The top of the rating awaits you!

notes.title: New game mode "Blitz"
notes.notes:
How is this mode different from regular battles?

- You start the battle with 6 Energy. 
- 2 cards come from the deck to the hand at the beginning of each turn. 
- Energy limit is 15, not 10. 
- In rewards, the values ​​of Generals prize experience have been significantly increased.

We don't know yet if this mode will take place in the Coliseum on a permanent basis or will be a recurring Event. We hope that you will help us make this decision by posting feedback and suggestions in the Game Communities.

notes.title: Small update 2021/04/29: Improving convenience
notes.notes:
Heroes of Eviron,

Tommorow we'll make a small update with some new usefull features:

- Card names returns to their place. Nice art is good, but some new players can't find names of cards, so we decided to return card names.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000082/e69641796674be43c37019d411eeadca265bf93f.jpg[/img]

- New system of cards backlighting. We like how it looks like and hope that you'll find it comfortable and useful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000082/24f4119d8ccb7772244639e7654fc30f1b5a4fd0.jpg[/img]

- Also we fixed some minor bugs in gameplay and localization. 

[b]We're waiting for your feedback about this update. Tell us how do you like new features. [/b]
